title: Private Console: Path-based SLA Explorer and Remediation Playbook
creator: Amina Patel
description: Design an interactive explorer inside the Private Console that maps tenant request paths (ingress -> routing -> cluster -> node pool) to measured SLA indicators (p99 latency, error rate, packet loss). The explorer should let operators: 1) surface the top N failing paths with cost and tenant exposure metadata, 2) pivot from a path line item to a suggested remediation playbook (configuration change, routing fallback, or temporary capacity bump), and 3) simulate rollback/rollforward effects on SLA and cost before applying changes. This ticket covers the high-fidelity prototype, component library variants, and a short playbook authoring UI for runbooks that SREs/tenant-ops can attach to a path. Focus on clarity at glance, progressive disclosure for deep diagnostics, and safe defaults for playbook actions.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype screens exist for: overview list of top failing paths, path detail drilldown with timeline + waterfall, remediation playbook editor, and simulation modal
Design tokens and component variants added to the Private Console design kit (path rows, risk badges, simulation sliders)
Hand-off spec includes annotated interaction notes for: how to trigger a canary rollback, how to bind playbooks to a path, and permissioning constraints
PM and Eng reviews completed with documented feedback and at least one feasibility adjustment logged
Clickable Figma prototype linked and validated in usability session with at least 3 operations engineers producing actionable feedback
